reason: Mineral crystals can strengthen the fibrous bone framework, matching the goal of giving the arm bones strength.
expectation: The mineral will combine with the collagen framework to form stronger bone.

effect: The mineralised framework shows how collagen and mineral contribute different mechanical properties; the bones still need living support.
reaction: The contrast between toughness and resistance to compression is satisfying and clear.
reason: Bone cells should make the mineralised framework living tissue.
expectation: The bone cells will be incorporated into the framework.

effect: The bone cells are embedded and connected within the matrix; blood vessels are a plausible next addition for living support.
reaction: The tiny channels make the idea of living cells inside hard bone more concrete.
reason: Blood vessels should supply the living bone tissue.
expectation: The vessels will be incorporated into the arm bones.

effect: The vessels supply nutrients to the embedded bone cells, completing the living bone framework. The elbow still needs its smooth surfaces and support.
reaction: The picture makes the route from vessels to bone cells clear.
reason: Articular cartilage forms smooth caps where the bones meet, so it is a plausible next addition.
expectation: The cartilage will cover the joint surfaces of the arm bones.

effect: The cartilage now covers the facing elbow surfaces, leaving the capsule and ligaments to support the joint.
reaction: The sliding inset makes the cartilage's role clear.
reason: The synovial capsule surrounds the joint and contains fluid, so it seems like the next part of the movable elbow.
expectation: The capsule will enclose the cartilage-covered elbow joint.

effect: The capsule encloses the joint, and its lining supplies fluid that helps the cartilage-covered surfaces glide. The ligaments remain to support the elbow.
reaction: The explanation connects the capsule and fluid to smooth movement clearly.
reason: The elbow ligaments span the joint and should provide the remaining support.
expectation: The ligaments will support the enclosed elbow joint.

effect: The ligaments completed the movable arm skeleton, showing support against sideways movement while allowing the elbow to bend.
reaction: The final picture brings the joint parts together clearly, though the last addition was predictable.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding mineral to the collagen framework was most worthwhile because the result explained how toughness and resistance to compression work together.

leastWorthwhile.text: The later joint additions became repetitive: each remaining part was added in a fairly obvious sequence, even though the explanations were useful.

surprise.text: The tiny channels connecting bone cells made living tissue inside hard bone more concrete.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the item descriptions gave each addition a plausible purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter to see how the muscle and skeleton work together, although I would hope for more meaningful choices than the predictable sequence here.
